关键词: James B. Braden appointed Chief Administrative Officer
主要内容: Kentucky Bancshares, Inc. announced that Director William Arvin retired from the company effective December 31, 2012. The retirement from the Board is effective at the end of the calendar year in which the retirement age is attained. Additionally, the company appointed James B. Braden as its Chief Administrative Officer of Kentucky Bank, its wholly-owned subsidiary, effective January 1, 2013. The announcement was made in a press release dated January 2, 2012, which was included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The report was signed by Gregory J. Dawson, Chief Financial Officer, on January 3, 2013.
